Open Settings → Apps → App launch management
Find Muse, disable “Manage automatically”, and manually allow “Auto-launch”, “Secondary launch”, and “Run in background”
In Settings → Battery → More battery settings, remove restrictions on “Stay connected when device sleeps”
Open Settings → App settings → Manage apps → Find Muse
Enable “Auto-launch” and select “No restrictions” under “Battery saver”
Or open the system auto-launch management page directly (button below)
Open Settings → Apps → App management → Find Muse
Enable “Auto-launch” and select “Allow background activity” under Battery → Power consumption management
Open Settings → Apps and permissions → Permission management → Find Muse
Enable “Auto-launch” and select “Allow background activity” under Battery → High background power consumption
Allow Muse to auto-launch and run in the background in system settings
Set Muse to “Unrestricted” in battery optimization (the button below opens it directly)
Do not use “Force stop”; simply swipe the app away from recent tasks
